system.description:
You are treated as having a "Breath Control" with SR +2 (it is acceptable to exceed the maximum SR). A battle armor infused with magical patterns through embroidery and dyeing, designed to efficiently respond to the earth's magic. When used in conjunction with a special breathing technique, it maximizes the wearer's natural healing ability.

Fragment of a Fist Master's Soul [Core Material] (140G) + Martial Arts Dress (120G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 8] (70G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (320G)
